title: Production Node-Wasm evaluator CLI
objective: Provide a fail-closed Node CLI around the exact production Wasm evaluator and artifact with file/stdin execution, timeout/reset behavior, and optional JSON route diagnostics

oracles: packages/flint-wasm production evaluator and Node kernel tests

handoff.summary: Hardened the existing Node-Wasm launcher into a fail-closed production-artifact CLI. It authenticates the manifest, receipt, every selected artifact byte, and the package-root runtime sources; supports file, stdin, and -c input; forwards evaluation timeouts and waits for worker recovery; offers an explicit REPL reset; and emits evaluator-owned JSON route receipts separately from ordinary output. Focused unit and real production-evaluator tests pass against artifact sha256:c6cdf576202bdd955b95aa90222c2f604aeb8227e193edbaac2232842fbbd00c.
risks: The complete distribution-lane portable/native/SEA matrix was not rerun; the repository build and exact Wasm artifact build passed, along with focused Node-Wasm tests.
Artifact verification intentionally hashes the full production asset set on each CLI process start; this harness favors exact evidence over startup latency.
next_steps: Cherry-pick this narrow commit into the integration branch and rebuild packages/flint-wasm/dist so runtime/node-cli.mjs and the production receipt bind the merged source.
No package manifest or test-registry wiring is required: the existing sagejs-wasm bin entry already names node-cli.mjs, and package tests discover test/*.test.mjs.
